probes.name: ward_worklist

"v1"."branch_number" > $3 THEN $4 || CAST("v1"."branch_number" AS text) || $5 || CAST("v1"."branch_version" AS text) ELSE $6 END)) AS "col1" FROM "ehr" AS "e0", "node" AS "n1", "vo_version" AS "v1", $8 AND "n1"."ehr_id" = "e0"."id" AND "v1"."ehr_id" = "e0"."id" AND "n2"."rm_type" IN ($9) AND ("n2"."arch_entity" = $10 AND "n2"."arch_major" = $11 AND ("n2"."arch_concept" = $12 OR "n2"."arch_concept" LIKE $13)) AND "n2"."vo_id" = "n1"."vo_id" AND "n2"."sys_version" = "n1"."sys_version" AND ("n2"."num" BETWEEN "n1"."num" AND "n1"."num_cap") AND "e0"."is_queryable" = $14 AND "a_v1"."id" = "v1"."audit_id" AND EXISTS(SELECT $15 FROM "node" AS "s0", "node" AS "s1", "node" AS "s2", "node" AS "s3" WHERE "s0"."vo_id" = "n2"."vo_id" AND "s0"."sys_version" = "n2"."sys_version" AND ("s0"."num" BETWEEN "n2"."num" AND "n2"."num_cap") AND "s0"."rm_type" IN ($16) AND LOWER("s0"."archetype") = LOWER($17) AND "s1"."vo_id" = "s0"."vo_id" AND "s1"."sys_version" = "s0"."sys_version" AND ("s1"."num" BETWEEN "s0"."num" AND "s0"."num_cap") AND "s1"."rm_type" IN ($18 /*, ... */) AND LOWER("s1"."archetype") = LOWER($19) AND "s2"."vo_id" = "s1"."vo_id" AND "s2"."sys_version" = "s1"."sys_version" AND ("s2"."num" BETWEEN "s1"."num" AND "s1"."num_cap") AND "s2"."rm_type" IN ($20 /*, ... */) AND LOWER("s2"."archetype") = LOWER($21) AND "s3"."vo_id" = "s2"."vo_id" AND "s3"."sys_version" = "s2"."sys_version" AND ("s3"."num" BETWEEN "s2"."num" AND "s2"."num_cap") AND "s3"."rm_type" IN ($22 /*, ... */) AND LOWER("s3"."archetype") = LOWER($23) AND CAST((jsonb_path_query_first("s3"."data", CAST($24 AS jsonpath)) #>> CAST($25 AS text[])) AS numeric) > CAST($26 AS numeric)) LIMIT $27
